name: Blunt to a fault
description: Says the true thing first and considers the damage afterwards.

name: Plans for the worst
description: Has an escape route from every room and a contingency for every friend.

name: Compulsively generous
description: Gives away more than they can spare, then quietly goes without.

name: Quietly vain
description: Would deny it, but checks their reflection in every dark window.

name: Fatally curious
description: Has never once left the strange door unopened.

name: Loyal past reason
description: Will defend a friend long after the friend stopped deserving it.

name: Trusts slowly
description: Assumes a motive behind every kindness, and is often right.

name: Relentlessly deadpan
description: Jokes with a straight face until someone finally laughs, or doesn't.

name: Short fuse, long apology
description: Snaps fast, regrets it faster, and makes amends at length.

name: Unnervingly patient
description: Will wait years for the right moment and never mention the waiting.

name: Can't stay still
description: Taps, paces, whittles — sitting through a meeting is physically painful.

name: Painfully formal
description: Uses full titles, even mid-brawl, and finds slang faintly distressing.

name: Deflects with self-mockery
description: Beats everyone to the insult so it stings less coming from them.

name: Perfectionist
description: Would rather deliver nothing than deliver something merely adequate.

name: Allergic to planning
description: Thinks best under pressure, and arranges to be under pressure often.

name: Compulsive collector
description: Pockets buttons, teeth, and pressed flowers, each with a reason.

name: Makes lists for everything
description: Writes tasks down after completing them just to cross them off.

name: Physically can't lie well
description: Tries, fails visibly, and has learned to just stay silent instead.

name: Lies for practice
description: Invents small untruths to keep the skill sharp, then forgets which ones.

name: Adopts strays
description: Collects lost people and animals and calls it a coincidence each time.

name: Turns everything into a contest
description: Including breakfast, directions, and grief.

name: Cheerful fatalist
description: Certain it all ends badly, and in excellent spirits about it.

name: Stubbornly hopeful
description: Has been proved wrong many times and has not adjusted.

name: Carries other people's guilt
description: Apologises for weather, for other people's tempers, for existing loudly.

name: Argues with gods
description: Prays regularly, mostly to complain, and expects a reply eventually.

name: Devout in small ways
description: Keeps every minor rite perfectly and never talks about belief.

name: Squeamish about blood
description: Copes fine in the moment and falls apart an hour later.

name: Sleeps badly
description: Takes the last watch by choice, because the dreams are worse.

name: Feeds people when worried
description: Anxiety converts directly into soup and unsolicited second helpings.

name: Hoards information
description: Knows things and shares them only when the price is right.

name: Chronic oversharer
description: Tells strangers the whole story within ten minutes, every time.

name: Miserly with coin
description: Grew up hungry and still counts the copper twice.

name: Money burns holes
description: Rich for three days after every job, then broke and philosophical.

name: Compulsive teacher
description: Cannot watch anyone do a thing badly without offering a correction.

name: Reflexively defiant
description: Says no first, then works out whether they actually objected.

name: Believes in the rules
description: Not out of fear — out of a conviction that order is a kindness.

name: Gallows humour
description: Funniest at funerals, which has cost them invitations.

name: Speaks slowly and rarely
description: So people lean in, and remember what was said.

name: Terrible with names
description: Gives everyone a nickname to cover it, and the nicknames stick.

name: Flinches from touch
description: Stands just outside arm's reach and doesn't explain why.

name: Talks with their hands
description: Grabs shoulders, straightens collars, and has broken two lamps this month.

name: Deeply superstitious
description: Will not start a journey on the wrong day, whatever it costs.

name: Refuses to believe in omens
description: Loudly, and slightly too often to be convincing.

name: Keeps their word absolutely
description: Which is why they are extremely careful about giving it.

name: Flirts as a reflex
description: Means almost none of it and is genuinely surprised when it lands.

name: Never complains
description: Which makes it very hard to tell when they've been badly hurt.

name: Incurably theatrical
description: Narrates their own actions and holds a pose a beat too long.

name: Awake before everyone
description: Uses the quiet hour to think, and resents company in it.

name: Prefers animals to people
description: Talks to every horse in the stable and learns their names first.

name: Keeps a written grudge list
description: Updated in a small book, with dates, and no entries ever crossed out.

name: Polite about violence
description: Warns you properly first, and means the warning kindly.

name: Quietly homesick
description: Cooks one dish from home badly and eats it anyway.

name: Never satisfied
description: Reaches the goal, feels nothing, and immediately sets a further one.

name: Cannot let an argument stand
description: Steps between people out of instinct, sometimes into the swing.

name: Hums without noticing
description: Always the same three bars, and nobody can identify the song.

name: Carries an unopened letter
description: Sealed, addressed to them, ten years old. They haven't been ready.

name: Owes a debt to a hag
description: The favour was granted. The price hasn't been named yet.

name: Uses a dead friend's name
description: Borrowed it in a hurry years ago and has never given it back.

name: The only one who came back
description: Six went in. The town still asks. They still don't answer.

name: Exiled from a title
description: Struck from the family rolls, and still holds the signet ring.

name: Raised by their people's enemy
description: Loved them. Buried them. Has never made either fact fit the other.

name: Named in a prophecy incorrectly
description: The verse fits them almost exactly, which is somehow worse.

name: Missing a year of memory
description: Other people remember them during it. Their accounts do not agree.

name: A scar in a shape
description: It looks like a sigil. They've been careful never to show a scholar.

name: Bound by a blood oath
description: Sworn at fifteen, to someone they now suspect was lying.

name: Expelled from their guild
description: For something they did do, defending someone who didn't.

name: Wanted in a neighbouring realm
description: The poster is unflattering and the charge is roughly accurate.

name: Inherited half a map
description: Someone else has the other half and is looking for them too.

name: Their god stopped answering
description: Two years ago, mid-prayer. The spells still work, which frightens them.

name: Died once already
description: Someone paid a great deal to bring them back and hasn't asked for anything yet.

name: Their familiar disappeared
description: No death, no goodbye. They still set out a second bowl.

name: Hunted by a sibling
description: Not for revenge. To bring them home, which is worse.

name: Walked away from a war
description: Their unit was ordered to do something. They left. Some of them didn't.

name: Carries a cursed heirloom
description: It works beautifully. Everyone who has owned it has ended the same way.

name: Followed by a polite ghost
description: Only they can see it. It has never once asked for anything.

name: Their village is under water
description: A dam, a flood, a decision made elsewhere. They keep the key anyway.

name: A fey godparent
description: Attends every birthday uninvited and expects to be introduced.

name: Dreams in a language they don't know
description: They've started writing it down. A scholar went pale at the sample.

name: In debt to a thieves' guild
description: The interest is jobs, not coin, and the jobs are getting worse.

name: Their papers are forged
description: Good work, expensive, and the forger has recently been arrested.

name: Spared by a monster
description: It looked at them, chose not to, and left. They need to know why.

name: Trained by someone infamous
description: They were kind, patient, and are now the subject of a manhunt.

name: Sends money home in secret
description: To an orphanage, a widow, or a debt that isn't theirs to pay.

name: Answers to two names
description: One from before, one from after, and only one is safe in this town.

name: Counting down to something
description: They know the date. They have not told a soul what happens on it.

name: Buried something dangerous
description: They remember the place exactly and check on it once a year.

name: Fled an arranged marriage
description: Two households are still looking, and one has stopped being polite.

name: Survived a plague that took everyone
description: No scars, no reason, and neighbours who never quite forgave it.

name: Knows a royal secret
description: Overheard, not sought. It's why they left the capital in a hurry.

name: Sole survivor of a wreck
description: Washed ashore holding a crate that wasn't theirs and never opened it.

name: Credited with someone else's deed
description: The ballad is wrong. Correcting it now would ruin more than one life.

name: Made a bargain with a dragon
description: Traded something small. The dragon has been unnervingly patient since.

name: Raised in a cult they escaped
description: Still mouths the mealtime prayer without meaning to.

name: Wearing an unfamiliar body
description: It answers to their mind but has old habits they didn't teach it.

name: Writes to a dead person weekly
description: Unsent, in a bundle, and someone has recently started writing back.

name: Broke an oath and got away with it
description: No lightning, no curse. The silence has been harder than punishment.

name: Hiding a child's existence
description: Fostered under a false name, in a town they no longer visit.

name: Already spent the reward
description: The job that earned it went badly and the client is still waiting.

name: Their tattoos are a record
description: One per person they failed. They are running out of forearm.

name: Banned from an entire city
description: By name, by decree, and for reasons they describe as a misunderstanding.

name: Owes their life to an enemy
description: Who is still alive, still an enemy, and has never mentioned it.

name: Turns every gift into a negotiation
description: Can't accept a kindness without offering something back immediately, to the point of insult.

name: Finishes other people's sentences
description: Guesses where a sentence is going and says it first, wrong often enough that people now leave pauses on purpose.

name: Counts under their breath when nervous
description: Steps, stairs, breaths — anything with a number gets one, and losing count starts the fear over.

name: Sharpens something when anxious
description: A blade, a stick, a pencil — whatever's at hand gets an edge before the worry does.

name: Apologises to furniture
description: Says sorry to doorframes, chairs, and the occasional cobblestone, and means it every time.

name: Their true name is carved where they can't reach it
description: A binder etched it into stone at the bottom of a lake, or a cliff face, or a locked vault. They've never seen it written.

name: The last living witness to a broken treaty
description: Signed on as a translator decades ago. Both sides now insist the terms were different, and only they remember which.

name: Inherited a debt they never agreed to
description: Their parent's creditor found them within a week of the funeral, contract in hand and their signature already on it.

name: Never orders first
description: Waits to hear everyone else's choice before naming their own, even when they decided minutes ago.

name: Corrects their own stories mid-telling
description: Stops a good story to fix a detail nobody else would have noticed was wrong, then loses the thread entirely.

name: Picks up a few words of every language they hear
description: Can swear fluently in eleven languages and hold a real conversation in none of them.

name: Sleeps with their boots on
description: Ready to move before they're fully awake, a habit nobody has managed to talk them out of.

name: Over-thanks people for small things
description: Turns a returned dropped glove into a three-sentence speech, and means every word of it.

name: Traded their reflection for a favour
description: Mirrors show the room empty where they stand. The favour was granted; what they paid it for, they won't say.

name: Stepped into a prophecy meant for someone else
description: The verse names their sister. Their sister said no. Nobody has explained what happens when the wrong person fulfils it.

name: Recognises a stranger's face from a childhood dream
description: Has seen this exact face in the same recurring dream since they were young. They have never once said so out loud.

name: States the odds before doing anything risky
description: Announces the exact chance of failure out loud, then does the risky thing anyway, every single time.

name: Reorganises other people's belongings
description: Can't leave a cluttered shelf alone, even in someone else's house, and is baffled when this causes offence.

name: Explains jokes instead of laughing
description: Hears a joke, works out exactly why it's funny, and says so out loud before anyone else can laugh.

name: Names every object they own for more than a week
description: A sword, a cart, a particularly reliable boot — all named, all discussed as if they have opinions.

name: Talks to plants and half expects an answer
description: Narrates the weather to every windowsill herb, and swears the basil listens better than most people.

name: Officially declared dead
description: The paperwork was filed years ago, properly and irreversibly. They've never found the right office to correct it.

name: Their name was the stake in a bet they lost
description: The winner gets to pick what they're called for a year and counting. They agreed to the terms sober, which is the humiliating part.

name: Followed by a crow that only steals useful things
description: Keys, coins, the exact tool needed a day later. They've stopped calling it a coincidence and started leaving offerings.

name: Waters down their own drink and says nothing
description: Nurses the same watered ale all night so nobody notices they're not really drinking, and never explains why.

name: Always insists on carrying the map
description: Trusts their own sense of direction over anyone else's, loudly, and is wrong about one time in three.

name: Rehearses apologies before giving them
description: Works out the exact wording in advance, and it still comes out wrong at the worst possible moment.

name: Reads the ending first
description: Needs to know how it turns out before they can enjoy how it happens, in books and in plans alike.

name: Physically cannot whisper
description: Every attempt at quiet carries clean across the room, so secrets get told in written notes instead.

name: Traded their voice for one true answer
description: Speaks now only in a stranger's borrowed voice. The answer they bought was worth it. They haven't told anyone what it was.

name: Wears the boots of someone who didn't come back
description: Broken in properly now. They've stopped apologising to them out loud, but they still take the same size everywhere they go.

name: Their entire guild was dissolved overnight
description: No trial, no explanation, just a notice nailed to the door. Everyone scattered and nobody has compared notes since.

name: Introduces their job before their name
description: Says what they do before who they are, and takes a beat too long to remember the second part sometimes.

name: Won't eat food they didn't watch being made
description: Finds a reason to be in the kitchen at every stop, and has gone hungry more than once rather than make an exception.

name: Stands to greet everyone, even people they dislike
description: Manners win over feelings every time, which makes it very hard to tell who they've actually forgiven.

name: Keeps both hands visible in unfamiliar company
description: An old habit from somewhere they won't name, and the one thing that makes new allies quietly nervous instead of reassured.

name: Splits every bill to the exact copper
description: Produces a working sum before anyone else has finished eating, and once ended a friendship over four coppers.

name: Voted alone against a plan that then succeeded
description: Nobody blames them for asking, but nobody quite trusts the win either, themselves included.

name: Carries a forged copy of their own family heirloom
description: Made it themselves years ago, for a reason they no longer fully trust, and isn't always sure anymore which one they're holding.

name: Knows a door that only opens once a decade
description: The next opening is close now. They still haven't decided whether to be there, or to warn anyone else away from it.

name: Corrects grammar mid-argument
description: Cannot let a dangling modifier go unchallenged, even while being threatened with a sword.

name: Reads every document aloud before signing
description: Twice through, out loud, no matter how impatient the room gets or how simple the paper looks.

name: Always the one who tends the fire at night
description: Wakes on their own every hour to check it, and has never once asked someone else to take the watch instead.

name: Tries every strange food exactly once
description: Never twice, whatever the verdict, on principle nobody has ever gotten them to explain.

name: Sides with whoever's losing an argument
description: Merit has nothing to do with it — once someone starts losing the room, that's the side they're on.

name: Born, officially, in two different towns
description: Both registries have the date right and the place wrong for each other. Neither town has noticed yet.

name: Owns the only key to a room they've never opened
description: Inherited both together. The house has been sold twice since, always with that one door still locked in the contract.

name: Cursed to tell only the truth for one year
description: The year ended months ago. They still haven't tested whether the habit or the magic was doing the work.

name: Double-knots absolutely everything
description: Boot laces, ship's rigging, a borrowed apron — if it can be tied, it gets tied twice.

name: Pays in exact change no matter how long it takes
description: Counts out the coppers one by one while a queue forms, and has never once apologised for it.

name: Won't travel without one specific worn object
description: A ring, a tooth, a button — replaced once and never again, after the one time they forgot it.

name: Laughs at their own joke before the punchline
description: Gives it away every time, and somehow still finds it funny enough to ruin on purpose.

name: Keeps score of who apologises first
description: Never says the count aloud, but always knows it, down to the exact argument.

name: Sent the anonymous tip that started a war
description: Meant to stop one death. Only they know whose handwriting was on the letter, and the war is still going.

name: Inherited a rival they've never met
description: The feud is generations old and entirely procedural now. Neither of them remembers what started it.

name: Knows what's actually in a famous dish
description: The sign says it's a family secret. It's actually an accident nobody's had the heart to correct in thirty years.

name: Won't walk under anything unfinished
description: Scaffolding, half-built arches, ladders — all get a wide detour, whatever the weather or the hurry.

name: Finishes everyone's abandoned drink
description: Can't stand to see it wasted, and has strong opinions about which combinations should never be mixed in one stomach.

name: Always offers their left hand to shake
description: For reasons rooted in an old promise, and it has cost them exactly as many friendships as you'd expect.

name: Calls back orders like a kitchen, even off duty
description: Repeats anything asked of them in a loud, rhythmic confirmation, which unnerves people who didn't grow up in a tavern.

name: Sleeps sitting up, always has
description: Can't explain it and has stopped trying to; a bed just feels wrong flat.

name: Ghost-wrote a dead author's most famous book
description: Signed away the credit for the money at the time. The money's long gone; the royalties keep arriving under the wrong name.

name: Was raised believing they were the eldest
description: Found the birth records by accident. Has not yet decided whether telling their siblings fixes anything.

name: Knows what a beloved local holiday is actually for
description: The parade is real. The reason for it was quietly rewritten two generations ago, and only their family kept the original.

name: Insists on their full title, then asks you to skip it
description: Makes you learn all nine words of it before admitting nobody's ever actually used them.

name: Has better manners for animals than people
description: Says please to a mule and skips it entirely with the mule's owner, and sees no contradiction there.

name: Narrates their own cooking out loud
description: Talks the pot through every step like it's listening, and gets genuinely offended when a dish doesn't cooperate.

name: Never lets anyone walk them all the way home
description: Peels off a street early every time, polite about it, and has never once explained where the rest of the walk goes.

name: Constantly corrects their own posture
description: Straightens up mid-sentence, mid-meal, mid-fight, on a discipline nobody ever asked them to keep.

name: Was the model for a famous statue
description: The sculptor took liberties. People recognise the statue immediately and never once recognise them.

name: Knows which grave in the churchyard is empty
description: Paid for, maintained, visited on the right days — and there has never been anyone in it. They arranged that personally.

name: Was taught to read by someone forbidden to teach
description: The lessons were illegal on both sides of that arrangement. Only one of them was ever caught.

name: Refuses to sit for a portrait or sketch
description: Turns away from every artist in every tavern, and has never once given a reason that satisfied anybody.

name: Finishes exactly at the deadline, never early
description: Could deliver it days sooner and simply doesn't, on a private schedule nobody has ever talked them out of.

name: Named their weapon, refuses to name their mount
description: Says naming a mount is asking for grief later, and has lost three unnamed ones anyway.

name: Always walks on the outside, nearer the traffic
description: Switches sides without a word whenever the street does, an old courtesy nobody's asked for in years.

name: Repeats a stranger's last few words as a question
description: A trick for buying thinking time that everyone notices and nobody has mentioned to their face.

name: Owns a deed to land that's now underwater
description: Bought it as an investment, dry, thirty years ago. Still pays the tax, on principle, to a crown that finds this hilarious.

name: Was briefly, legally married to a ghost
description: Settled an inheritance dispute and nothing else. The paperwork was real. Explaining it at parties has never once gone well.

name: Knows the words that end a curse, not who's under it
description: Learned the counter-charm from a dying stranger who never said the target's name. They've been listening ever since.

name: Tips before the service, never after
description: Says it gets better work out of people, and has never once tested whether that's actually true.

name: Checks every mirror is actually a mirror
description: Taps the glass, watches the delay, and has never explained what convinced them not to trust one on sight.

name: Remembers people by scent, not face
description: Recognises an old friend by their soap before their face registers, and finds portraits nearly useless.

name: Keeps a moment of silence before every meal, even alone
description: Nobody taught them this. They started it themselves and have never skipped it, not even mid-argument.

name: Always leaves before the performance ends
description: Missed every ending in living memory on principle, and has strong theories about most of them anyway.

name: Caused the incident a famous law is named after
description: The statute doesn't use their name. Everyone in the profession still calls it by the story instead.

name: Carries a banned book entirely in memory
description: The last written copy burned years ago. They've never once written it back down, and haven't said why.

name: Was paid to forget something that keeps coming back
description: The spell was supposed to be permanent. Fragments surface anyway, usually at the worst possible moment, and they've stopped telling anyone which ones.

name: Insists on lighting every candle in the room personally
description: Won't let anyone else near the tinderbox, and has never given a reason beyond 'I've got it.'

name: Corrects the time on every clock they pass
description: Carries their own accurate time and silently judges every public clock that disagrees with it.

name: Brings their own chair to other people's gatherings
description: Claims every other chair in the world is built wrong, and has never once been talked out of hauling theirs along.

name: Won't call a task finished until they say so out loud
description: The work can be complete for an hour before they finally announce it, usually to an empty room.

name: Says goodbye to a room, not just the people in it
description: A quiet word to the doorway or the hearth on the way out, and has never once explained who it's really for.

name: Born during the one total eclipse anyone alive remembers
description: The town still marks the date without quite saying why, and has never once asked how they feel about that.

name: Promised the same locked box's contents to three different people
description: None of them know about the other two. The box has been closed longer than any of the promises have existed.

name: Received a letter exactly one year late, from someone since dead
description: The post office has no explanation. The letter reads like it was written yesterday, about things that haven't happened yet.
